data.one_liner: Dart library for converting standard data types to a binary format and back
data.what_it_does: It encodes supported primitive types, Uint8List, String, Map and List into a binary representation. It can also decode that binary back into the original Dart values.
use_when: You need a simple way to serialize data for storage or network transmission without external dependencies
You work on a single platform or control both ends of the communication and can tolerate the dart2js int‑as‑double limitation
avoid_when: You require high‑performance streaming or large‑scale binary protocols
You need custom object serialization or schema evolution support
strengths: Supports common Dart collections and primitive types
Null‑safe and works on all Flutter platforms
weaknesses: No support for custom class serialization
